title: Neue Online-Plattform für Interieur-Gläser
summary: Die neue Online-Plattform raumglas.de des Flachglas MarkenKreis bietet umfassendes Wissen über den Einsatz von Glas im Innenraum. Nutzer finden kreative Anregungen, technische Hinweise und eine digitale Musterkollektion für Interieur-Gläser. Die Plattform vereint praktische Informationen und ästhetische Aspekte für Innenarchitekten und Planer.

title: Mehr Sicherheit für die Planung von Gläsern
summary: The Bundesverband Flachglas has updated its guideline BF Merkblatt 019/2015 for glass design, focusing on practical applications under the latest DIN 18008 standards. The revised document clarifies normative requirements and provides practical tips to enhance safety and efficiency in glass applications. This initiative aims to offer engineers and planners a reliable resource in anticipation of the forthcoming Eurocode for glass.

title: Schüco bündelt Kunststoffgeschäft in iberischer Tochtergesellschaft
summary: Schüco has established a new subsidiary, Schüco Polymer Iberia S.L., to enhance its presence in the Iberian markets of Spain and Portugal starting May 1, 2026. This move aims to strengthen partnerships and service offerings in the region, supported by a new logistics hub in Valdemoro. The initiative underscores Schüco's commitment to developing premium system solutions and improving logistical performance.

title: Titelstory: Wie Forel die Glasbearbeitung revolutionierte
summary: The article celebrates Forel's 50-year journey in revolutionizing glass processing, starting from a small workshop in Treviso, Italy. It highlights the family's innovative approach, including the shift to vertical glass processing, which led to patented solutions in insulation glass manufacturing. Additionally, it discusses Forel's expansion into Germany and their development of advanced insulation glass lines.

title: Sicherheitsexperte Marcel Philipp verstärkt GU BKS Service als Projektleiter
summary: Marcel Philipp has been appointed as the new project manager for GU BKS Service GmbH, bringing over ten years of experience in critical infrastructure and security systems. He will oversee project management and lead the project teams to enhance operational efficiency. Philipp's expertise includes security-critical applications and regulatory requirements related to critical infrastructures.

title: Julien Thiery leitet jetzt Marketing & Sales bei Swisspacer
summary: Julien Thiery will assume the role of Marketing & Sales Director at Swisspacer starting May 1, 2026, succeeding Sarah Sattler. With extensive experience from the Saint-Gobain Group, he aims to enhance customer proximity, innovation, and market strategy. CEO Matthias Bach expresses confidence in Thiery's ability to drive Swisspacer's strategic development further.

title: Die aktuellen Fenstermarkzahlen für Deutschland
summary: The recent conference on market statistics in Frankfurt highlighted the resilience of the window industry in Germany, predicting a growth of 1.9% to 3.1% for windows and 1.8% to 2.9% for exterior doors in 2026. Despite geopolitical uncertainties and a backlog in housing supply, experts emphasize the necessity of stable investment conditions. The conference underscored the importance of addressing housing shortages and adapting to evolving market demands.

title: Wartungsarm und wetterbeständig: Kneer-Südfenster setzt auf modifiziertes Holz
summary: Kneer-Südfenster utilizes modified wood in its Duo-Kantel construction for enhanced durability and reduced maintenance. The combination of weather-resistant Accoya wood outside and natural pine inside significantly prolongs surface longevity. This innovative approach meets modern demands for energy efficiency, stability, and design flexibility.

title: Markttest Fenster Österreich: Internorm sichert sich Gesamtsieg vor Velux und Josko
summary: Internorm has once again emerged as the overall winner of the Market Quality Award, showcasing its brand strength and future readiness with a remarkable 88% purchase willingness among consumers. This marks the fifth consecutive year that Internorm leads in the window category, significantly ahead of competitors Velux and Josko. The research underscores Internorm's commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction in the window industry.

title: Fachliteratur im Fokus
summary: The article discusses two complementary technical books: "Professionell Dübel setzen für Dummies" focuses on practical know-how for fastening techniques on construction sites, while "Befestigung und Abdichtung von Fenstern und Türen" delves into planning and building physics. Both books provide essential guidance for professionals in the window and solar shading industries, highlighting their relevance for both practical application and adherence to regulations. Collectively, they bridge the gap between practical implementation and theoretical understanding critical for modern construction challenges.

title: Salamander auf der Frontale: Schlanke Fenster, große Formate, weniger CO₂
summary: Salamander presents innovative window solutions at the Fensterbau Frontale, focusing on slim designs and large formats while improving CO2 balance. Co-CEO Till Schmiedeknecht discusses new approaches in modern window construction, emphasizing material efficiency and unique designs like the Greta-Dinkel window. Their offerings target both historical and contemporary architectural needs, showcasing large elements up to 2.8m tall.

title: Remmers von der Frontale: Zirkulationsholz einfach erklärt
summary: The article discusses how old scaffolding boards are transformed into sustainable circulation wood for future window manufacturing. It highlights Remmers' innovative Eco-coating system that utilizes renewable resources. This approach promotes resource-efficient coatings and aligns with environmental standards for future tenders.

title: MACO im Frontale-Gespräch: Diese Innovationen bewegen den Fenster- und Türenmarkt
summary: During the Fensterbau Frontale, MACO showcased innovations such as Smart-Home sensors and a new bodenschwelle designed for modern window construction. The company emphasizes customer dialogue to develop solutions addressing future challenges. Their latest products aim to enhance smart connectivity and offer practical solutions for window manufacturers.

title: Frontale-Video von Ventana: Wenn Fensterbau anders gedacht wird
summary: In einem Video von der Messe Frontale präsentiert Ventana Geschäftsführer Stefan Schwanekamp innovative Ansätze im Fensterbau mit gebogenen Elementen und großflächigen Hebeschiebetüren. Die Diskussion umfasst technische Unterstützung und die europaweite Partnerschaft im Fenstersonderbau. Eine Zusammenfassung der neuen Möglichkeiten und Produkte für die Fensterindustrie wird gegeben.

title: Fenstertuning: Mit Fensterfalzlüfter, Dichtung und Insektenschutz
summary: Der GW-Thementag zum Fenstertuning präsentierte innovative Lösungen zur Verbesserung von Lüftung, Dichtungen und Insektenschutz. Experten zeigten, wie Fensterbauer Wohnkomfort und Energieeffizienz steigern können. Eine abschließende Diskussion beleuchtete die Praxis und Herausforderungen in der Fensterbranche.

title: Siegenias smarter Fenstergriff wird noch intelligenter
summary: Siegenia has launched the second generation of its smart window handle, which now features Matter compatibility for seamless integration with various smart home systems such as Apple Home and Google Home. This new version boasts improved mechanical design and monitoring capabilities, allowing users to control their windows digitally via an app. Enhanced security and energy efficiency are also key benefits, as it connects with other smart devices to optimize home comfort.

title: Sälzer entwickelt Fenster und Türen für neue Bedrohungslagen
summary: Sälzer has developed new window and door systems tailored to combat vandalism, adhering to the newly introduced ift guideline EI-06/1. This guideline establishes standards for vandalism resistance, differentiating it from traditional burglary attempts. Sälzer's solutions emphasize robust designs while integrating existing safety requirements.

title: Türen-Tuning: Assa Abloys smarte Antwort auf störrische Türen
summary: Assa Abloy's new Solution Locks integrate innovative tilting bolt technology to provide robust burglary protection while ensuring ease of use. This technology mitigates pressure from temperature changes and warped door components, allowing for smooth operation even with multiple locking points. Ideal for high-security environments, these locks fulfill advanced requirements for panic exit devices.

title: Das Abstell-Schiebefenster mit KI-Lüftung
summary: KDM Innovation presents Movista, a mechatronic window fitting that combines automated tilting with manual sliding. Designed to optimize room climate using AI, it delivers up to five times the air exchange of traditional windows. This innovative fitting allows for seamless integration into building facades, offering both functionality and modern aesthetics.

title: Magnetmodule lassen Mammut-Fenster mühelos gleiten
summary: Die Magnetschwebetechnologie von d-lev ermöglicht es, bis zu 1,5 Tonnen schwere Schiebeelemente mit minimaler Zugkraft mühelos zu bewegen. Dieses System funktioniert ohne Motorisierung und reibende Komponenten, was es wartungsarm macht. Entwickelt in Zusammenarbeit mit Ironlev, ist es speziell für filigrane Profilsysteme optimiert, um moderne architektonische Lösungen zu unterstützen.

title: Wie Fenzi lückenlose Regelkonformität gewährleistet
summary: Die Fenzi Group gewährleistet mit geprüften Formulierungen und umfassender Rückverfolgbarkeit die Konformität zu den neuen CAM-Anforderungen für Isolierglas. Die Vorschriften fordern Transparenz in der Materialwahl und das Vermeiden kritischer Stoffe wie SVHC, um Sicherheit und Qualität zu garantieren. Ihr Engagement für nachhaltige Lösungen wird durch klare Dokumentation und die Einhaltung von Umwelt- und Gesundheitsstandards unterstrichen.

title: AGC: Transluzente Flächen für Architektur und Innenausbau
summary: AGC's Matelux glass combines high light transmission with effective privacy, expanding its application from traditional interiors to translucent facades. Its unique texture allows architects creative freedom in designing spaces that are bright yet shielded from outside view. The glass is versatile and can be treated for various architectural needs while maintaining durability and aesthetic appeal.

title: Transparente feco Arbeitswelten für die Schaeffler AG
summary: The Schaeffler AG has developed a transparent interior concept for its new project and technology center in Bühl, featuring flexible system glass walls over 15,000 m². This design fosters communication, sustainability, and acoustic quality with areas for meetings, labs, and workshops. Incorporating wood and glass, the architecture promotes an open, adaptable work environment that meets modern mobility challenges.

title: Frerichs Glas: 44 neue Ornament- und Dekorgläser im Programm
summary: Frerichs Glas expands its design collection with 44 new ornamental and decorative glasses, offering diverse options for architects and designers. The collection features various patterns and surface finishes, enhancing both aesthetics and functionality in modern spaces. Comprehensive support is provided from planning to execution, ensuring tailored solutions for individual projects.

title: Treffen Sie Europas größten Hersteller von Aluminium-Haustüren
summary: Inotherm is a leading Slovenian manufacturer of aluminum front doors, known for quality and innovative design. Celebrating 35 years, the company produces over 44,000 doors annually and emphasizes energy efficiency and security. With a customized approach to design, Inotherm caters to diverse architectural needs while expanding its product range.

title: Wenn sich Türfüllung und Flügel magisch anziehen
summary: Deceuninck introduces a new door concept using Frager's patented Magnetude technology, which eliminates the need for adhesives and minimizes installation issues. The innovative design allows for easy on-site assembly and a wide selection of over 500 customizable panel designs. This advancement reduces production time and material complexity, enhancing overall efficiency in door manufacturing.

title: Wasser Marsch!
summary: Warema prioritizes comprehensive testing for snow loads and rainfall to ensure robust outdoor solutions. Their rigorous approach exceeds standard requirements, simulating real weather conditions during assessments. This commitment to quality results in safe and reliable structures that provide long-lasting outdoor living spaces.

title: Allen Komfortansprüchen gerecht
summary: The article discusses the renovation of the La Quercetta estate, emphasizing the integration of KE solutions to harmonize functionality and aesthetics in outdoor spaces. It highlights four distinct products used to enhance guest experiences, including the Kedry Prime bioclimatic pergola and Qubica Light shading system. The renovations aim to create sophisticated environments that blend luxury with the natural surroundings.
